manifest.name: v1-affine-yaw-correction
manifest.notes: V1 baseline (kinematic single-track + understeer + first-order lag + per-segment delta0) with a per-platform affine correction (gain, bias) on the yaw-rate output. Coefficients in coeffs.json fitted by least-squares on full sim/segments; route_cv_sigma per platform from 5-fold route-grouped CV. Tesla falls through to V0 passthrough.

coefficients._note: Per-platform affine yaw-rate correction on top of V1: yr = gain*yr_v1 + bias. Fitted on full sim/segments via least-squares. route_cv_sigma is 5-fold route-grouped CV std-dev of the bias term.
